gloss: rapeseed; canola; the seeds of the rape plant

definitions.gloss: rapeseed; canola; the seeds of the rape plant
definitions.explanation: The seeds of the rape plant (Brassica napus), widely cultivated for producing cooking oil. The bright yellow blossoms of the rapeseed plant are an iconic symbol of spring in Japan.

examples.japanese: {菜種|なたね}{油|あぶら}で{料理|りょうり}する。
{春|はる}になると{菜種|なたね}の{黄色|きいろ}い{花|はな}が{一面|いちめん}に{咲|さ}く。
examples.english: When spring comes, the yellow flowers of rapeseed bloom across the fields.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{古|ふる}くから{菜種|なたね}を{栽培|さいばい}して{油|あぶら}を{搾|しぼ}り、{灯|あか}りや{調理|ちょうり}に{使|つか}っていた。
examples.english: In Japan, rapeseed has been cultivated since ancient times to press oil, which was used for lighting and cooking.

notes:
The seeds of the rape plant (Brassica napus), widely cultivated for vegetable oil production. The yellow-flowered {菜|な}の{花|はな} (rapeseed blossom) is an iconic symbol of spring in Japan. The oil extracted from the seeds, {菜種油|なたねあぶら}, is one of the most commonly used cooking oils.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {菜種油|なたねあぶら}: rapeseed oil, canola oil
- {菜種|なたね}{梅雨|づゆ}: spring rain during rapeseed flowering season (March-April)
- {菜種|なたね}を{搾|しぼ}る: to press rapeseed (for oil)
- {菜種|なたね}{畑|ばたけ}: rapeseed field

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {菜|な}の{花|はな}: rapeseed blossoms — the flowers of the same plant, often eaten as a vegetable
- {大豆|だいず}: soybean — another oilseed crop important in Japanese cuisine
